verdict.rationale: BigCommerce has a dedicated first-party Webhooks section in its developer docs (/docs/integrations/webhooks), which includes Google Cloud Platform Pub/Sub webhooks. That is the product's own event-subscription capability, but the pack contains only page titles, so registration, payloads and event coverage are not shown. Missing for 10: documented steps to register outbound HTTP callbacks, a list of subscribable event types, payload, retry and security details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
